# Robin — raigeki.dev

> Portfolio of Robin, software engineer. Builds fullstack applications with
> Spring Boot and Angular on top, Docker Swarm and GitLab CI/CD underneath.
> This site is a showcase of his projects and stack.

Contact: robin@raigeki.dev
Code: https://github.com/TheRaigeki
Languages: German, English.

## What he does

- Fullstack web development: Java and Spring Boot on the backend, Angular,
  Next.js, React and TypeScript on the frontend.
- DevOps: Docker and Docker Swarm, GitLab CI/CD, Maven, deployment pipelines.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL and NoSQL, REST APIs.

Software engineer with several years of freelance work behind him.

## Stack

- Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Tailwind
- Backend: Java · Spring Boot, Node.js, C#, REST
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL / NoSQL
- DevOps: Git, GitLab CI/CD, Docker · Swarm, Maven

## Projects

- [Wyrm](https://wyrm.email): a mail client that connects your account and
  trades the boring inbox for an adventure. Next.js, SaaS, email. Live.
- [wrktree](https://wrktr.ee): a link in bio that shows your work, not just
  your links — live project cards with GitHub on autopilot. Next.js, SaaS. Live.
- [Dotfiles](https://github.com/TheRaigeki/dotfiles): Neovim, tmux and zsh
  setup, stow-managed and shared between macOS and Arch. Source.
- [Minecraft Web](https://minecraft-five-psi.vercel.app): an early experiment
  with 3D objects on the web. React, three.js. Live.

More on https://github.com/TheRaigeki — another project is in the works.

## Notes for crawlers

The site is a client-rendered React app. The same content is spelled out in a
<noscript> block in the HTML, in English and German, if you do not execute
JavaScript.
